cs.label: [section] Požadavky na ukončení:
cs.content: Zápočet a zkouška. Podmínkou k získání zápočtu je vypracování průběžně zadávaných programů, alespoň 80% účast na semestrálních cvičeních a krátký teoretický test. Zkouška se skládá z části ústní, teoretické. Požadované znalosti odpovídají rozsahem sylabu.

en.label: [section] Aim of the course and learning outcomes:
en.content: Students will get the basic information about polygonal network computations, setting-out methods, tacheometry and maps production. Basic knowledges obtaining about area and cubature determination, data collection by GNSS, photogammetry and laser scanning.

en.label: [section] Course content:
en.content: 1.Measuring connected to the triangulation network. (allowance 1/1) a.Geodetic bases,b.Triangulation and troilateration.c.Points monumentation and targeting.2.Horizontal and vertical controls. (allowance 1/2) a.Division of point fields.b.Nets of elevation point.3.Topographical surface and terrain relief. (allowance 1/3) a.Form of terrain relief.b.Basic lines and cuts.4.Tacheometry. (allowance 1/6) a.Tacheometry principles.b.Detailed tacheometric survey.5.Calculation work. (allowance 1/3) a.Tacheometric equations.b.Calculation of point coordinates.6.Projection work. (allowance 1/3) a.Visualition terrain on maps.b.Planimetric and hypsometric plan.7.Setting-out. (allowance 1/3) a.Basic words, setting-out network.b.Basic methods.c.Computation setting-out data.d.Setting-out of space position.8.Determination area and cubature. (allowance 1/3) a.Graphical and computation method.b.Area calculation from coordinate.c.Shrinkage paper.d.Computation of cubature.9.Global Navigation Satellite System. (allowance 1/3) a.Fundamental notions, history.b.Measuring principle.c.An overview of methods measuring.d.Receivers and accuracy.10.Photogrammetry. (allowance 1/3) a.Terminology, measuring principle.b.Methods of measuring.c.Unmanned aerial vehicle.d.Accuracy and utilization.e.Advantages, disadvantages.11.Laser scanning. (allowance 1/3) a.Terminology, measuring principle.b.Methods of measuring.c.Accuracy and utilization.d.Advantages, disandvantages.12.Cartography and map series. (allowance 1/3) a.An overview of basic cartographic projection.b.Basic structure of maps.c.Cartometry.13.Traverse nets. (allowance 1/3) a.Polygonal traverses.b.Computation of polygonal traverse.14.Cadastre and Land Records. (allowance 1/3) a.State Administration of Land Surveying and Cadastre.b.Consultation of the Cadastre of Real Estate.c.Practical work with Real Estate Cadastre data.d.Geoportal.
